title: Cambridge Primary Computing Curriculum Framework (0059) — butir Stage 4–6 yang dikutip publik
version: Published September 2021 for first teaching September 2022 (Cambridge internal file ref tcm142-635600)
notes: Pelengkap cambridge-primary-computing.json (Stage 1–2) untuk track KODE SD4–SD6. Berkas lama tidak diubah.
Hanya kode yang dikutip lengkap dengan kodenya di halaman Cambridge Community (situs Cambridge International) yang ditandai verified: true. Sumber dan cara baca sama dengan berkas Stage 1–2.
5CS.01: kode dan awal kalimat terbaca, tetapi teksnya terpotong di alat pembaca halaman; verified: false sampai teks lengkap dicek di PDF framework.

Halaman yang sama memuat contoh progresi strand Computational Thinking per stage TANPA kode, mis. Stage 4 'Follow, understand, edit and correct algorithms that use iteration, including count controlled loops', Stage 5 '... algorithms that contain selection', Stage 6 'Follow and understand algorithms that are presented as flowcharts'. Karena kodenya tidak tertulis, butir itu sengaja tidak dimasukkan; kompetensi yang bersandar padanya memakai refs kosong dengan catatan.
Tindak lanjut: unduh Curriculum Framework 0059 lengkap dari Cambridge Primary support site (butuh akun sekolah) lalu lengkapi Stage 3–6, termasuk strand Managing Data.

entries.text: Know how to develop programs with repetition.
Know how to develop programs with iteration.
Describe the scale of the computing devices and mechanisms that are connected to the internet, either for data input… (teks terpotong)
Identify issues that may occur as a result of a failure of the internet.
Know that the same sub-routine can be used multiple times in an algorithm.
Know how to develop block-based programs with a procedure (sub-routine) to define commonly used sections of code.
Identify benefits of using robotics in industry, such as car manufacturing or food production.
